title: Lateness Multiplier on Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Late Charges
content:
# Collections Training Q&A — The Lateness Multiplier, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Rule.** For the late charge on a unit's most recent rental invoice month under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the charge after the minimum is multiplied by the late-charge lateness multiplier: 1.25 where 30 or more days have passed since the invoice due date, 1.10 where 15 to 29 days have passed, and 1 where fewer than 15 days have passed.

**Q. Which due date?**
A. The invoice due date printed on the unit's most recent rental invoice.

**Q. How are the days counted?**
A. From that due date to today; days between two dates count the later date but not the earlier one.

**Q. What does each band give?**

| Days since the invoice due date | Lateness multiplier |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 1.25 |
| 15 to 29 | 1.10 |
| fewer than 15 | 1 |

**Q. Where are the edges? (hypothetical, due date on day 0)**
A. Today on day 14: 14 days, multiplier 1. Day 15: 15 days, 1.10. Day 29: 29 days, 1.10. Day 30: 30 days, 1.25.

**Q. Hypothetical effect?**
A. A charge after the minimum of 28.00 with 31 days passed since the due date becomes 35.00; with 20 days passed, 30.80.
